primary.evidence: prev_complete=false interpreted as single accepted beat despite four sent legal multibeat examples and an explicit previous-clock definition

secondary.alias_presentation: Short trace aliases acc/prev/k are not explicitly mapped to the SVA signal names in a dedicated schema; facts remain available and consistent.
secondary.reset_interface: The generated rst antecedent is cancelled by the wrapper disable iff(rst). That wrapper is not explicitly disclosed in the request. This is a separate interface-disclosure issue, not the cause of the eight length false alarms.
secondary.long_feedback: Only one complete response; 5539 input tokens and ten public records do not establish that the request was too long or that shortening it would help.

decision.current_protocol: STOP. No unchanged-prompt retry, second call, rule change, or retrospective acceptance.
decision.presentation_comparison: Conditionally justified as a separate public generation-capability study, not mechanism value. Local evidence supports testing explicit sample-to-signal/anchor/check presentation, but does not predict improvement.
prerequisites: Disclose the fixed clock/reset wrapper to BOTH arms as a common interface fact and revalidate locally.
Fix the same model, initial candidate, full development facts, sampling, native acceptance and budget; vary only data presentation.
Do not add correct replacement predicates, handwritten successful sets or independent data to either arm.
Seal a new protocol and obtain its own bounded authorization before execution; research179 unused conditional call is unavailable.
No full accepted version => stop; accepted version => freeze then fresh independent evaluation; no rerolls.
decision.suggested_upper_bound_if_later_selected: Two presentation arms x at most two model calls (generation and one own actual-feedback refinement), no retry/expansion. Proposed only, not sealed or authorized.
